changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION data.get_last_price(p_id_symbol integer) RETURNS numeric LANGUAGE sql AS $$ /* Return last known C price from internal kline (external - candle) */ with cndl as ( /* last 1m candle */ select max(c.id) as max_id from data.candle c where c.id_symbol = p_id_symbol and c.c_interval = '1' and c.ts_db > localtimestamp - interval '5 minutes' and -- for eliminating full scan round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (localtimestamp - c.ts_db))) between 0 and 60 ) select k.c from data.kline k where k.id_candle = (select max_id from cndl) and k.ts_db = ( select max(ki.ts_db) from data.kline ki where ki.id_candle = (select max_id from cndl) ); $$ ;
